The Confirmation | The Confirmation is a 2016 Canadian drama film starring Clive Owen, Jaeden Lieberher, and Maria Bello. Bachelor Apartment | Bachelor Apartment is a 1931 American pre-Code RKO comedy/romance film directed by and starring Lowell Sherman as a womanizing playboy who falls in love with Irene Dunne's honest working girl.  The credits for the film, and all sources from that time show that the film was based on a story by New York playwright John Howard Lawson, the screenplay was adapted by J. Walter Ruben.  However, Lawson would later claim that the final screenplay had not been altered from what he had originally written. List of multiplanetary systems | From the total of 2,751 stars known to have exoplanets (as of none }} ), there are a total of 616 known multiplanetary systems, or stars with at least two confirmed planets, beyond the Solar System. The star with the most confirmed planets is our Sun with 8 confirmed planets, while the stars with the most confirmed exoplanets are Kepler-90, HD 10180, HR 8832 and TRAPPIST-1, with 7 each; in 2012, two more candidates were suggested for HD 10180.

Jupiter Ascending | Jupiter Ascending is a 2015 space opera film written, produced, and directed by The Wachowskis.
